test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average height of 20 students of Class 9 is 147 cm and the average height of 15 students of Class 10 is 154 cm. What is the average height (in cm) of the students of the two Classes?
solution:
**Formula:**

Average height = Sum of the heights of the students ÷ Total students

**Calculation:**

Sum of the heights of student of class 9 = 147 × 20 = 2940 cm

Sum of the heights of student of class 10 = 154 × 15 = 2310 cm

Total sum = 2940 + 2310 = 5250 cm

Total students = 20 + 15 = 35 

Average = 5250over35 = 150 cm

∴ **The average height of the students is 150 cm. **
